insight.headline: Order Update Taxes
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the Shopify Storefront API and the GraphQL Admin API. The recalculation occurs as of August 31, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to account for the tax recalculation. This change may impact custom checkout implementations, particularly those using the Storefront API or the GraphQL Admin API. Developers should test their applications to ensure compatibility with the updated tax calculation. The orderUpdate mutation now requires consideration of tax implications when modifying shipping addresses.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when shipping addresses are updated, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and reducing potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures merchants remain compliant with tax regulations. It also simplifies the development process by automating tax recalculation.

recap.headline: Shopify updates Hydrogen, GraphQL Admin API, and more

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have been updated to version 13.0.3 and 4.2.1 respectively.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Platform and App Updates
themes.detail: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, and the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement. Merchants can also see partner details on collaborator requests, and the orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated.
